items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses and 2 condos and townhomes listed in Oxford Heights. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Oxford Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 33% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Oxford Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses and 1 condos and townhomes sold in Oxford Heights over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 5 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Oxford Heights compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Oxford Heights held 9.8% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 0.9% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 88.2% of the 17 homes listed in Oxford Heights and condos and townhomes made up 11.8%; of the 5 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Oxford Heights than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 19 to 15 (−21.1%) and condos and townhomes rose from 1 to 2 (+100.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
